questions.q: Find the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Banana, Potato
questions.e: Apple, mango and banana are fruits; potato is a vegetable.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Eagle
questions.e: Tiger, lion and leopard are mammals (big cats); an eagle is a bird.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 3, 5, 7, 9
questions.e: 3, 5 and 7 are prime numbers; 9 = 3 × 3 is composite.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 16, 25, 36, 15
questions.e: 16, 25 and 36 are perfect squares (4², 5², 6²); 15 is not.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: A, E, K, O
questions.e: A, E and O are vowels; K is a consonant.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Rose, Lotus, Jasmine, Mango
questions.e: Rose, lotus and jasmine are flowers; mango is a fruit.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Square, Rectangle, Triangle, Cylinder
questions.e: Square, rectangle and triangle are flat two-dimensional polygons; a cylinder is a three-dimensional solid.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 27, 64, 125, 144
questions.e: 27, 64 and 125 are perfect cubes (3³, 4³, 5³); 144 = 12² is not a cube.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: AC, EG, IK, MP
questions.e: In AC, EG and IK the second letter is two places after the first. In MP the gap is three places (M to P).

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Iron, Copper, Silver, Bronze
questions.e: Iron, copper and silver are pure metals (elements). Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 17, 23, 29, 33
questions.e: 17, 23 and 29 are primes; 33 = 3 × 11 is composite.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Keyboard, Mouse, Scanner, Monitor
questions.e: Keyboard, mouse and scanner are input devices; a monitor is an output device.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: BDF, HJL, NPR, TVY
questions.e: In BDF, HJL and NPR each letter is two places after the one before. In TVY the gaps are 2 and 3, so it breaks the pattern.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 12–144, 9–81, 7–49, 8–60
questions.e: In the other three the second number is the square of the first (12², 9², 7²). 8² = 64, not 60.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Python, Java, C, Windows
questions.e: Python, Java and C are programming languages; Windows is an operating system.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Compiler, Interpreter, Assembler, Debugger
questions.e: A compiler, an interpreter and an assembler all translate a program into machine-executable form. A debugger only helps find faults and does not translate.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: BY, DW, FU, HT
questions.e: In BY, DW and FU the two letters have positions adding up to 27 (2+25, 4+23, 6+21), i.e. they are mirror letters. H and T add up to 8 + 20 = 28.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 226, 257, 401, 210
questions.e: 226 = 15² + 1, 257 = 16² + 1 and 401 = 20² + 1: each is one more than a perfect square. 210 is not (14² = 196, 15² = 225).

questions.q: Find the odd one out: 6–42, 7–56, 8–72, 9–80
questions.e: In the other three the second number is n × (n + 1): 6 × 7, 7 × 8, 8 × 9. For 9 it should be 9 × 10 = 90, not 80.

questions.q: Find the odd one out: Sitar, Veena, Sarod, Tabla
questions.e: Sitar, veena and sarod are string instruments; the tabla is a percussion instrument (a pair of drums).
